import os, time

opmode = app.OperatingMode

scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6

scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

    opmode.Mode = opmode.Mode.Tapping if hasattr(opmode.Mode, 'Tapping') else opmode.Mode

zctrl.SetPoint = 0.1

# Optional: adjust PID gains for gentle feedback (use modest values)
zctrl.PGain = 1000
zctrl.IGain = 500

# Define output directory and filename
base_dir = r"C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\corral\corral\tasks\afm\src\afm\gpt_oss_subtask_3_11_tool_calling\enviroment\subtasks_3"

filename = os.path.join(out_dir, "scan_10x10um_128x128.tif")

# Start the scan

# Wait for scan to finish – poll the scan state
while app.IsScanning:
    time.sleep(0.5)

# Retrieve the image object (assuming app.Image returns an image with a Save method)
image = app.Image
# Save the image to the defined path
image.Save(filename)

# Clean up
spm = None
print("Image saved to:", filename)
"}

opmode = app.OperatingMode
head = app.ScanHead

    print(f"Scanning... lines remaining: {remaining}")
    time.sleep(2)

import nanosurf, time, os, glob

# Initialize SPM

scan = app.Scan

# Wait until scanning finishes
while scan.IsScanning:
    remaining = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning... lines remaining: {remaining}")
    time.sleep(2)
print("Scan completed.")

# After scan, the image is saved automatically. Find the most recent image file.
# Assume images are saved under the workspace directory in a subfolder "images" or similar.
workspace = r"C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\corral\corral\tasks\afm\src\afm\gpt_oss_subtask_3_11_tool_calling\enviroment\subtasks_3"
# Search for common image extensions
patterns = ["*.tif", "*.tiff", "*.png", "*.jpg", "*.bmp"]
files = []
for pat in patterns:
    files.extend(glob.glob(os.path.join(workspace, "**", pat), recursive=True))
if not files:
    print("No image files found.")
else:
    latest = max(files, key=os.path.getmtime)
    print("Latest image file:", latest)
    # Write the path to a temporary file for retrieval
    with open(os.path.join(workspace, "latest_image_path.txt"), "w") as f:

import os, time, nanosurf, traceback

# Initialize SPM interface
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
app = spm.application

# Configure scan parameters
scan = app.Scan
scan.ImageWidth = 30e-6  # 30 µm

scan.Points = 128
scan.Lines = 128
# Center at (0,0) default

# Set scanning mode to Tapping to minimize tip damage
# Assuming API provides a method to set mode

    app.OperatingMode.setMode('Tapping')

    # fallback if different API
    try:
        app.OperatingMode.Mode = 'Tapping'
    except Exception:
        pass

# Optionally set gentle Z-controller gains
zctrl = app.ZController
zctrl.PGain = 500  # lower gain for gentle feedback
zctrl.IGain = 100

# Start scan
app.StartScan()

# Wait for scan to finish (polling)
while app.IsScanning():
    time.sleep(1)

# After scan, retrieve latest image path
